result.question: Qual a taxa de mortalidade por nivel de instrucao?
result.gold_sql: SELECT ins."DESCRICAO" AS nivel_instrucao, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN instrucao ins ON i."INSTRU" = ins."INSTRU" GROUP BY ins."DESCRICAO" ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade DESC;
